name: Bowl of Everfood
body:
Aura faint conjuration; CL 4th; Slot none; Price 360 gp; Weight 2 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This heavy iron bowl produces a nutritious meal that only a beast would find palatable. Once per day, upon command the bowl fills with a nutritious meal of liver and fish flavored mush. Most carnivorous animals enjoy the flavor, and some anumi find that the meal bears a sense of nostalgia. Other creatures find it to be inedible.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, create food and water; Cost 180 gp.
